$comment: Manual corrections to fold decisions, consulted by resolveRoot before anything else. `fold_into` needs a targetGameId; `keep_separate` gives a game its own title despite IGDB folding it; `hide` drops it entirely. Every entry needs a note — a fold decision with no rationale cannot be reviewed later. Entries marked `generated: "crown"` come from `deno task overrides:crown` (a port that far outranks the original it was ported from becomes the title, and the original folds under it); that task rewrites exactly those entries and leaves hand-written ones alone, and skips any pair a hand-written entry already covers.
